title: Scaffold Express TS API with SQLite schema
description: Initialize Express + TypeScript project in workspace/simple-notes-api with SQLite database schema for notes table.
steps: Initialize npm project with package.json in workspace/simple-notes-api
Install dependencies: express, better-sqlite3, uuid, zod, tsx, typescript, @types/node, @types/express, @types/better-sqlite3, @types/uuid, vitest, supertest, @types/supertest
Create tsconfig.json with ES2022 target, strict mode, outDir dist
Create src/db.ts with Better-SQLite3 connection and notes table creation (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)
Create src/index.ts with basic Express server skeleton (port 3001)
Add npm scripts: dev (tsx watch src/index.ts), build (tsc), start (node dist/index.js), test (vitest run)
Run initial build to verify TypeScript compiles
acceptance_criteria: workspace/simple-notes-api/package.json exists with express, better-sqlite3, zod, typescript dependencies
workspace/simple-notes-api/src/db.ts creates SQLite notes table on startup
npm run build succeeds without TypeScript errors
